key_insight: The paper shows that renewable PPAs are not just fixed-price contracts: their fair value and risk depend strongly on the contract structure and the underlying renewable generation profile.
engineering_relevance: For solar and wind project developers, the framework helps price PPAs more realistically and quantify how much revenue protection is traded off against upside participation.
method: Formalizes payoff structures for common fixed-price and non-standard PPA designs
Derives fair contract prices using financial valuation principles
Uses Monte Carlo simulation with a continuous-time solar irradiance model for risk assessment
evidence_signal: An empirical study on the Italian electricity market shows that fair prices and risk profiles vary substantially across technologies and contract structures.
watch_item: The pricing and risk outputs depend on model assumptions and market conditions, so calibration quality and regime changes can materially affect results.
paper_title: Beyond the Fixed Price: Valuation and Risk of Non-Standard Renewable PPAs
